title: The push-forward density θ·L_#ξ is Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable
statement: Let P, Q, n ∈ ℕ and let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open. Let M ⊆ ℝ^P, θ : ℝ^P → ℝ and ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) satisfy IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ. Let L : ℝ^P → L(ℝ^P, ℝ^Q) be Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable, where Hⁿ = μHE[n]. Then x ↦ θ(x)·L(x)_#ξ(x) = θ(x) • nVectorPushforward n (L x) (ξ x) ∈ Λ_n(ℝ^Q) is Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable.
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n) (L : Eucl P → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl Q)), IsOpen U → IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → AEStronglyMeasurable L ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M) → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => θ x • nVectorPushforward n (L x) (ξ x)) ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M)
